name: driver-intent
ruleAdd: The content field is one utterance spoken by a truck driver in a road freight scenario. Each question below describes one driver intent. Judge every question independently: does the utterance express that intent? Multiple intents may hold at the same time.
ruleSearch: The content field is a natural-language search request over a database of truck driver utterances. Each question below describes one intent category. Judge every question independently: does the request ask for utterances expressing that intent? Multiple intents may hold at the same time.
otherYes: The content expresses some demand or intent that none of the other questions in this group covers.
otherNo: Every demand or intent expressed in the content is covered by the other questions in this group.

children.name: PRICE
children.yes: The utterance is mainly about money: freight price, driver pay, or payment settlement.
children.no: The utterance is not mainly about money, freight price, or payment settlement.

children.name: HIGHER_PAY
children.yes: The driver asks for a higher freight rate or extra payment for this order.
children.no: The driver does not ask for a higher freight rate or extra payment.

children.name: LOW_RATE
children.yes: The driver complains that the freight rate is too low or that the trip loses money.
children.no: The driver does not complain that the rate is too low or the trip loses money.

children.name: PAYMENT_TERMS
children.yes: The driver talks about unpaid freight, settlement, deposit, or when the payment arrives.
children.no: The driver does not talk about unpaid freight, settlement, deposit, or payment timing.

children.name: CARGO
children.yes: The utterance is mainly about cargo: loading, load quantity, or cargo condition.
children.no: The utterance is not mainly about cargo, loading, or cargo condition.

children.name: REDUCE_LOAD
children.yes: The driver says he will load less than the full cargo or refuses to take part of the cargo.
children.no: The driver does not refuse or reduce any part of the cargo.

children.name: CARGO_DAMAGE
children.yes: The driver reports damaged cargo or asks for compensation for damaged goods.
children.no: The driver does not report damaged cargo or claim damage compensation.

children.name: LOADING
children.yes: The driver talks about loading or unloading work, its responsibility, or its fees.
children.no: The driver does not talk about loading or unloading work, responsibility, or fees.

children.name: SCHEDULE
children.yes: The utterance is mainly about delivery time, lateness, or order fulfillment.
children.no: The utterance is not mainly about delivery time, lateness, or order fulfillment.

children.name: LATE_DELIVERY
children.yes: The driver warns that the delivery will arrive late or asks others to accept a delay.
children.no: The driver does not warn about any delay in delivery.

children.name: CANCEL_ORDER
children.yes: The driver wants to cancel this order or refuses to take this trip.
children.no: The driver does not want to cancel the order or refuse the trip.

children.name: DEADHEAD
children.yes: The driver asks for compensation for an empty return trip or deadhead miles.
children.no: The driver does not ask for compensation for an empty return trip.

children.name: SERVICE
children.yes: The utterance is mainly about people: their attitude, service quality, or an evaluation of them.
children.no: The utterance is not mainly about people, their attitude, or service quality.

children.name: COMPLAINT
children.yes: The driver complains about a person, a dispatcher, or the service.
children.no: The driver does not complain about any person or the service.

children.name: PRAISE
children.yes: The driver praises a person or the service.
children.no: The driver does not praise any person or the service.

children.name: 中文话术筛选
children.ruleAdd: 这条内容是一句公路货运场景里司机或货主说出的话术。下面每个问题描述一种意图，请对每个问题独立判断：这句话术是否表达了该意图？多个意图可以同时成立。
children.ruleSearch: 这条内容是对公路货运司机话术库的一次自然语言检索请求。下面每个问题描述一类意图，请对每个问题独立判断：该请求是否在找表达了这类意图的话术？多个意图可以同时成立。
children.yes: 这条内容用中文表达，且是道路货运场景里司机或货主的一句话术，或是对这类话术的检索请求。
children.no: 这条内容不是中文的道路货运场景话术，也不是对这类话术的检索请求。

children.name: 运费价格
children.yes: 这条话术主要在谈钱：运费价格、司机工钱或运费结算。
children.no: 这条话术没有主要在谈钱、运费价格或运费结算。

children.name: 要求涨价
children.yes: 司机要求提高这一单的运费，或追加额外费用。
children.no: 司机没有要求提高运费，也没有追加额外费用。

children.name: 嫌运费低
children.yes: 司机抱怨运费太低、这一趟不赚钱或亏本。
children.no: 司机没有抱怨运费低、不赚钱或亏本。

children.name: 讨要运费
children.yes: 司机在讨要未结算的运费，或在谈运费到账时间、定金或结算方式。
children.no: 司机没有讨要运费，也没有谈到账时间、定金或结算方式。

children.name: 空驶补贴
children.yes: 司机为空车返程或放空里程索要补贴或报销。
children.no: 司机没有为空驶里程索要补贴或报销。

children.name: 货物装卸
children.yes: 这条话术主要在谈货物：装卸货、拉多少货或货物状况。
children.no: 这条话术没有主要在谈货物、装卸货或货物状况。

children.name: 减少拉货
children.yes: 司机说这一单要少拉一部分货，或拒绝拉其中一部分。
children.no: 司机没有要少拉货，也没有拒拉部分货物。

children.name: 货物破损
children.yes: 司机报告货物破损变形，或为破损货物索要赔偿。
children.no: 司机没有报告货物破损，也没有为破损索要赔偿。

children.name: 装卸责任
children.yes: 司机在谈装卸的活谁干、装卸费谁出。
children.no: 司机没有在谈装卸的活或装卸费的分担。

children.name: 时效履约
children.yes: 这条话术主要在谈送货时间：晚点、取消或装货安排。
children.no: 这条话术没有主要在谈送货时间、晚点或履约安排。

children.name: 延迟送达
children.yes: 司机说这一单会晚到，或请收货方接受延迟。
children.no: 司机没有说会晚到，也没有请对方接受延迟。

children.name: 取消订单
children.yes: 司机想取消这一单，或拒绝接这一趟。
children.no: 司机没有想取消订单，也没有拒接这一趟。

children.name: 约装货时间
children.yes: 司机在约定或修改装货、到厂的具体时间安排。
children.no: 司机没有在约定或修改装货、到厂时间。

children.name: 路况延误
children.yes: 司机报告堵车、封路、天气等路况造成的行程延误。
children.no: 司机没有报告路况或天气造成的行程延误。

children.name: 服务互动
children.yes: 这条话术主要在谈人：对方态度、服务质量或对人的评价。
children.no: 这条话术没有主要在谈人的态度、服务质量或对人的评价。

children.name: 投诉抱怨
children.yes: 司机在抱怨或投诉某个人、调度或平台服务。
children.no: 司机没有抱怨或投诉任何人或服务。

children.name: 表扬感谢
children.yes: 司机在表扬或感谢某个人或服务。
children.no: 司机没有表扬或感谢任何人或服务。

children.name: 联系沟通
children.yes: 司机要求对方联系自己，或在谈电话打不通、消息没人回这类沟通问题。
children.no: 司机没有要求联系，也没有谈电话或消息沟通问题。
